groups.activity: clan research: Detonite Injector, then Ignis

rows.label: Detonite Injector research
rows.note: 72h, 5,000 cr, 2,000 affinity; start first, it unlocks Ignis

rows.label: Ignis research
rows.note: 72h, 5,000 cr, 3,000 affinity; queueable only after the Injector

conditions: The clan needs a built Chem Lab, and the two timers stack to about six days.
In an established clan this is usually done already and costs you nothing.
bonuses: Farm Ampules and Injector Invasions during the two 72-hour timers.

disclosures.title: what each research consumes
disclosures.body: Detonite Injector: 5 Detonite Ampule, 200 Ferrite, 250 Polymer Bundle, 100 Plastids. Ignis: 10 Detonite Ampule, 400 Ferrite, 150 Plastids, 500 Polymer Bundle. Figures are for the smallest clan tier and scale up with clan size.

conditions: Mastery Rank 5 is required to use it.

groups.activity: Grineer Invasions that pay Detonite Injectors
groups.meta: 3 per Invasion; one covers the recipe

rows.label: Detonite Injector
rows.note: pays as the finished resource, not a blueprint
rows.alt: or craft: 15,000 cr blueprint, 10 Ampule, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage, 250 Plastids, 12h each

conditions: The Injector blueprint is single-use, so crafting means re-buying it for each of the two.
The reward offered rotates; open the Invasions tab and pick the Grineer side.
bonuses: Orb Vallis tier 4 bounties can pay Detonite Injectors, and rare Grineer storage containers occasionally drop one.

groups.activity: any Grineer mission, as you play

rows.label: Detonite Ampule
rows.note: research; 20 more if you craft the two Injectors

conditions: Do not let Plastids run dry; the Injector research and crafts both draw on them.
bonuses: Ampules drop on Mercury, Earth, Ceres, Saturn, Uranus, Sedna, Lua and the Kuva Fortress; Earth sabotage caches pay about 12%.

rows.label: Ignis
rows.note: 2 Detonite Injector, 5,000 Nano Spores, 5,000 Ferrite, 1 Forma

conditions: Ignis Wraith needs this weapon first, but its Mastery is separate.
